title: Mobile Project Profile v1
description: EPIC M1.01 of docs/plan/MOBILE-PLATFORM-ROADMAP-1.0.18.md. A factual, generated-and-reviewed record of what a mobile project actually is, so mobile_plan_compiler.py's semantic plan can be split from framework-specific materialization without guessing the stack. scripts/mobile_project_profile.py is a read-only detector: it never writes project code, and every field it cannot support with real evidence is left NO-DATA rather than guessed. Only the keyword subset scripts/mobile_project_profile.py actually enforces is used here (matching mobile-journey-contract-v1.json's own convention): type, required, properties, enum, const, items, minItems, additionalProperties.

schema_version.description: Which shape this record follows, so a reader never has to guess.

project_id.description: A stable identifier for the profiled project. Names the founder's own priority mobile projects by ROLE ONLY when this record is stored inside Brother, per the standing never-name-the-app rule; never the project's private name.

profiled_revision.description: The exact git revision the detector ran against. A profile is only valid for this revision under the caller's own staleness policy; the schema does not enforce freshness itself.

platforms.description: Platforms this project actually has real, detected indicators for. Never a guess: an empty array is honest NO-DATA, not 'none supported'.

frameworks.description: Detected frameworks (e.g. 'ios-swiftui', 'ios-uikit', 'android-gradle'), each one backed by a real file the detector found, named in evidence_refs.

source_roots.description: Repository-relative directories the detector found real project files under.

build_systems.description: Detected build systems (e.g. 'xcodebuild', 'gradle', 'spm'), each backed by a real file named in evidence_refs.

test_frameworks.description: Detected native test frameworks (e.g. 'xctest'), each backed by a real file named in evidence_refs.

confidence.description: The detector's own honest confidence in this profile as a whole: 'high' (multiple independent indicators agree), 'low' (exactly one weak indicator), or 'none' (nothing detected at all, every other field is empty/NO-DATA by construction).

evidence_refs.description: Repository-relative paths to the real files the detector actually found and read, one per claim above. An empty array means confidence must be 'none'; the detector enforces this by hand rule, not by this schema alone.
